raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN GOT >= 60 THEN ID END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ID), 0) AS abnormal_rate
FROM main."Laboratory"
WHERE "Date" >= '1997-01-01' 
    AND "Date" <= '1997-12-31'
    AND "Date" <= '1998-06-01'
```
